rust_summary: runtime item and block sprite overrides (`item_sprite_set`, `item_sprite_reset`, `block_sprite_set`, `block_sprite_reset`, `item_sprite_pixels`, `block_sprite_pixels`).
doc_summary: Overrides an item's shared-atlas sub-rectangle or a block model texture layer at runtime, or resets it back to the active resource pack texture. Wrong dimensions or byte lengths return an error cleanly. item_sprite_pixels and block_sprite_pixels read the current RGBA8 pixels (including mod overrides) from the CPU copies of the atlas, with no GPU readback.
